name: AncientMegatheriummon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] For each card with the [Hybrid] trait in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash 1 digivolution card from the bottom of each of your opponent's Digimon. Then, for each Digimon your opponent has with no digivolution cards, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
[On Deletion] You may play 1 blue level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait from your hand without paying its memory cost.
